Amelia Park: Hi all  Amelia here, starting today on eng-platform! Quick checks: laptop arrived, trying to enroll M1/M2 Mac. Where's the VPN guide and badge pickup? Also big sticker collector here :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Tom (DevEx): welcome Amelia!! VPN guide is pinned in #devex. For Apple Silicon run:
```bash
sudo profiles install /opt/redwood/mdm.mobileconfig
sudo jamf enroll || true
```
If JAMF shows pending >10m ping me. Badge pickup goes through People Ops (Priya).

onboard-bot: New hire account created: Amelia Park. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/amelia_park. VPN cert request queued (ETA ~20m).

Priya Rao (People Ops): Hi Amelia  welcome! We left a welcome kit on your desk and mailed one to your home (tracking 1Z888AA10123456000). Badge ready after 2pm at security. Team lunch Friday 12:30 if you want to join.

Nico Vargas: hey Amelia  I'm your onboarding buddy. First-week ramp is a tiny README update in infra/docs to get you familiar with CI. Pairing today at 3pm PT?

Amelia Park: 3pm PT works, thanks everyone! Also where do I find the internal model demo repo links so I can skim before pairing?

Tom (DevEx): added the links to your checklist and DM'd a short starter checklist. See you at 3pm :slightly_smiling_face:
